# ToolVerse (`https://toolverse.baby/`)

> ToolVerse is a privacy-first free online tools platform for PDFs, images, calculators, writing/academic helpers, SEO utilities, developer tools, regional Pakistan finance estimates, and multi-source job discovery. Most file tools process data in the browser (Canvas / WebAssembly / Web Crypto) without uploading documents to ToolVerse servers.

## What is ToolVerse?

ToolVerse (toolverse.baby) provides 88+ live browser utilities with no signup wall for core workflows. Contact: support@toolverse.baby. About: https://toolverse.baby/legal/about

## High-intent tools

- [Compress Image to Target Size](https://toolverse.baby/tools/compress-image-target-size): Exact KB targets (20KB / 50KB / 100KB) for portals.
- [Merge PDF Files](https://toolverse.baby/tools/pdf-merge): Private client-side PDF combine.
- [HEIC to JPG](https://toolverse.baby/tools/heic-to-jpg): iPhone photos for Windows/forms.
- [QR Code Generator](https://toolverse.baby/tools/qr-code-generator) / [Barcode Generator](https://toolverse.baby/tools/barcode-generator)
- [Pakistan Salary Tax Estimator](https://toolverse.baby/tools/pakistan-salary-tax-estimator) / [Zakat Calculator](https://toolverse.baby/tools/zakat-calculator)
- [Global Job Finder](https://toolverse.baby/tools/global-job-finder): Discovery only — apply on original postings.
- [Meta Tag Generator](https://toolverse.baby/tools/meta-tag-generator) / [UTM Builder](https://toolverse.baby/tools/utm-builder)
